067/**
068 * Different database jdbc drivers support different type conversion;
069 * this utility class juggles types around.
070 * <p>
071 * TODO: Consider situations where JDBC does the requested conversion and so
072 *       nothing to do. Maybe such a thing is checked before doing the convert
073 *       methods. Like "verifyConvertToType()" below; "checkDriverConvertToType()".
074 *
075 */
076public class ConvertType {
077  private ConvertType() {}
078
079  /**
080   * To override default type mapping for local/dbms requirements.
081   * An entry with "Exception.class" generates an exception.
082   * <p>
083   * TODO: API/plugin
084   */
085  private static final EnumMap<JDBCType, Class<?>> overrideJdbcToJavaType
086      = new EnumMap<>(JDBCType.class);
087  static {
088    overrideJdbcStandard();
089  }
090  private static void overrideJdbcStandard() {
091    // The *_WITH_TIMEZONE aren't mentioned in appendix B.1 or B.3
092    overrideJdbcToJavaType.put(JDBCType.TIME_WITH_TIMEZONE, OffsetTime.class);
093    overrideJdbcToJavaType.put(JDBCType.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE, OffsetDateTime.class);
094
095    // overrideJdbcToJavaType.put(JDBCType.SMALLINT, Byte.class);
096    // overrideJdbcToJavaType.put(JDBCType.TINYINT, Short.class);
097  }

099  // Only types listed here allowed for "findJavaTypeClass()";
100  // overrideJdbcStandard above is checked first/before.
101  // clang-format off
102  private static final Set<JDBCType> handledJavaTypeClass = EnumSet.of(
103      INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT, BIGINT,
104      REAL, FLOAT, DOUBLE, DECIMAL, NUMERIC,
105      BIT, BOOLEAN,
106      DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP,
107      CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR);
108  // clang-format off

110  /**
111   * Throw if the specified JDBCType is not convertible, using methods in this
112   * class, to the type. Typically used during bind.
113   * <p>
114   * The exception is thrown whether assertions are enabled or not.
115   * <p>
116   * TODO: or is automatically converted by JDBC driver?
117   *
118   * @param jdbcType jdbc column type
119   * @param targetType target type
120   * @param allow only allow these JDBC types, may be null
121   * @throws AssertionError if can't handle conversion to JDBCType
122   */
123  public static void assertConvertFromJdbcType(JDBCType jdbcType, Class<?> targetType,
124                                               EnumSet<JDBCType> allow) {
125    if (allow != null && !allow.contains(jdbcType))
126      throw new AssertionError(sf("'%s' not allowed in '%s'", jdbcType, allow));
127    if (!checkConvertFromJdbcType(jdbcType, targetType, allow))
128      throw new AssertionError(
129          sf("'%s' to '%s' conversion not supported", jdbcType, targetType.getName()));
130  }
131
132  /**
133   * Check if the specified JDBCType is convertible, using methods in this
134   * class, to the type.
135   * <p>
136   * TODO: or is automatically converted by JDBC driver?
137   *
138   * @param jdbcType jdbc column type
139   * @param targetType target type
140   * @param allow only allow these JDBC types, may be null
141   * @return true if conversion is handled
142   */
143  public static boolean checkConvertFromJdbcType(JDBCType jdbcType, Class<?> targetType,
144                                                 EnumSet<JDBCType> allow) {
145    if (allow != null && !allow.contains(jdbcType)) return false;
146    if (targetType == null) return true;
147    try {
148      Clazz sourceJDBC = getClazz(findJavaTypeClass(jdbcType));
149      Clazz target = getClazz(targetType);
150
151      if (sourceJDBC != null && target != null) {
152        if (sourceJDBC.isDateTime() && target.isDateTime()) {
153          return checkConvertFromJdbcDateType(sourceJDBC, target);
154        }
155        // All number to number types supported.
156        if (sourceJDBC.isNumeric() && target.isNumeric()) return true;
157        switch (target) {
158          case BOOL -> {
159            if (sourceJDBC == Clazz.BOOL || sourceJDBC.isNumeric()) return true;
160          }
161          case LONG, INT, SHORT, BYTE, FLOAT, DOUBLE, BIGD -> {
162            if (sourceJDBC == Clazz.BOOL) return true;
163          }
164        }
165      }
166    } catch (SQLException ex) {}
167    return false;
168  }
169
170  /** Both source and target are date */
171  // TODO: OFFSETTIME, OFFSETDATETIME
172  private static boolean checkConvertFromJdbcDateType(Clazz sourceJDBC, Clazz target) {
173    if (sourceJDBC == target) return true;
174    return switch (target) {
175      case UTILDATE -> true;
176      case DATE -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
177          case TIMESTAMP -> true;
178          default -> false;
179        };
180      case TIME -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
181          case TIMESTAMP -> true;
182          default -> false;
183        };
184      case TIMESTAMP -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
185          case DATE, TIME -> true;
186          default -> false;
187        };
188      case LOCALDATE -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
189          case DATE -> true;
190          default -> false;
191        };
192      case LOCALTIME -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
193          case TIME -> true;
194          default -> false;
195        };
196      case LOCALDATETIME -> switch (sourceJDBC) {
197          case TIMESTAMP -> true;
198          case DATE -> true;
199          default -> false;
200        };
201      default -> false;
202    };
203  }
204
205  /**
206   * Check if the specified sourceType is convertible, using methods in this
207   * class, to the JDBCType.
208   * <p>
209   * TODO: or is automatically converted by JDBC driver?
210   *
211   * @param jdbcType target jdbc type
212   * @param sourceType source type
213   * @param allow only allow these JDBC types, may be null
214   * @return true if conversion is handled
215   */
216  public static boolean checkConvertToJdbcType(JDBCType jdbcType, Class<?> sourceType,
217                                               EnumSet<JDBCType> allow) {
218    if (allow != null && !allow.contains(jdbcType)) return false;
219    if (sourceType == null) return true;
220    try {
221      Clazz targetJDBC = getClazz(findJavaTypeClass(jdbcType));
222      Clazz source = getClazz(sourceType);
223
224      if (targetJDBC != null && source != null) {
225        if (targetJDBC == source)
226          return true;
227        if (targetJDBC.isDateTime() && source.isDateTime()) {
228          return checkConvertToJdbcDateType(targetJDBC, source);
229        }
230        // All number to number types supported.
231        if (targetJDBC.isNumeric() && source.isNumeric()) return true;
232
233        switch (source) {
234          case BOOL -> {
235            if (targetJDBC == Clazz.BOOL || targetJDBC.isNumeric()) return true;
236          }
237          case LONG, INT, SHORT, BYTE, FLOAT, DOUBLE, BIGD -> {
238            if (targetJDBC == Clazz.BOOL) return true;
239          }
240        }
241      }
242    } catch (SQLException ex) {}
243    return false;
244  }
245
246  /** Both source and target are date. B.5. */
247  // TODO: OFFSETTIME, OFFSETDATETIME
248  private static boolean checkConvertToJdbcDateType(Clazz targetJDBC, Clazz source) {
249    if (targetJDBC == source) return true;
250    return switch (targetJDBC) {
251      case DATE ->
252        switch (source) {
253          case TIMESTAMP, UTILDATE, LOCALDATE, LOCALDATETIME -> true;
254          default -> false;
255        };
256      case TIME ->
257        switch (source) {
258          case TIMESTAMP, UTILDATE, LOCALTIME, LOCALDATETIME -> true;
259          default -> false;
260        };
261      case TIMESTAMP ->
262        switch (source) {
263          case DATE, TIME, UTILDATE, LOCALDATETIME -> true;
264          default -> false;
265        };
266      default -> false;
267    };
268  }

279  /**
280   * Convert the specified object to the object type
281   * for the specified JDBCType.
282   * This is not just casting; for example Boolen to Integer.
283   * The same object may be returned.
284   * <p>
285   * Note the spec B.2 vs B.4 updater methods vs setObject;
286   * and B.5 for setObject when a target type is specified.
287   * TODO: Is this is for when a target JDBCtype is NOT specified
288   * or in the setObject (not appendix B.5).???
289   *
290   * @param value
291   * @param jdbcType
292   * @return
293   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
294   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B.4 Java Object Types Mapped to JDBC Types
295   */
296  // TODO: move to the following?
297  //@see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B.5 Conversions by setObject and setNull from Java Object Types to JDBC Types
298  public static Object convertToType(Object value, JDBCType jdbcType) throws SQLException {
299    Class<?> type = findJavaTypeClass(jdbcType);
300
301    Object target = internalConvertObject(value, type);
302    if (target == CanNotConvert)
303      throw new SqlConversionException(
304          sf("Missing conversion %s to %s", value.getClass().getName(), jdbcType));
305    return target;
306  }
307
308  /**
309   * Convert specified value to specified type; this can be more than a cast.
310   * The same object may be returned.
311   *
312   * @param <T> target type
313   * @param value value to convert
314   * @param type class of target type
315   * @return converted type, may be the same object
316   * @throws dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.SqlConversionException
317   */
318  // TODO: handle primitive types??? See enum Clazz for notes.
319  public static <T> T convertToType(Object value, Class<T> type) throws SqlConversionException {
320    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
321    T target = (T) internalConvertObject(value, type);
322    if (target == CanNotConvert)
323      throw new SqlConversionException(
324          sf("Missing conversion %s to %s", value.getClass().getName(), type.getClass().getName()));
325    return type.cast(target); // TODO: Don't really need the cast, but it's cheap.
326  }
327
328  private static BigDecimal bdMaxLong = BigDecimal.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE);
329  private static BigDecimal bdMinLong = BigDecimal.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE);
330
331  /**
332   * Return something of the specified type,
333   * unless can't convert then "CanNotConvert" Object is returned.
334   */
335  private static Object internalConvertObject(Object sourceValue, Class<?> type)
336      throws SqlConversionException {
337    if (sourceValue == null || type.isAssignableFrom(sourceValue.getClass())) return sourceValue;
338
339    Clazz source = getClazz(sourceValue.getClass());
340    Clazz target = getClazz(type);
341    if (source == null || target == null) return CanNotConvert;
342
343    if (source.isDateTime() && target.isDateTime()) {
344      if (source == target) return sourceValue;
345      return internalConvertObjectDateType(sourceValue, source, target);
346    }
347
348    if (source.isNumeric() && target.isNumeric()) {
349      // Throw if detect overflow/underflow
350      // Match.toIntExact(longVal)
351      Number n = (Number) sourceValue;
352      Number result = 0;
353      boolean bigdOflow = false;
354      switch (target) {
355        case LONG -> {
356          result = n.longValue();
357          if (source == Clazz.BIGD) {
358            BigDecimal bd = (BigDecimal) n;
359            if (bdMinLong.compareTo(bd) <= 0 && bd.compareTo(bdMaxLong) <= 0) return result;
360            bigdOflow = true;
361          }
362        }
363        // clang-format off
364        case INT -> { result = n.intValue(); }
365        case SHORT -> { result = n.shortValue(); }
366        case BYTE -> { result = n.byteValue(); }
367        case FLOAT -> { return n.floatValue(); }
368        case DOUBLE -> { return n.doubleValue(); }
369        case BIGD -> {
370          switch (source) {
371            case LONG, INT, SHORT, BYTE -> { return BigDecimal.valueOf(n.longValue()); }
372            case FLOAT, DOUBLE -> { return BigDecimal.valueOf(n.doubleValue()); }
373            case BIGD -> { return n; }  // Should have been caught at entry.
374          }
375        }
376          // clang-format on
377      }
378      if (result.longValue() != n.longValue() || bigdOflow)
379        throw new SqlConversionException(sf("Convert %s to %s: %s", n, target, "overflow"));
380      return result;
381    }
382
383    // clang-format off
384    switch (sourceValue) {
385      case Boolean b -> {
386        Number n = b ? 1 : 0;
387        switch(target) {
388          case LONG -> { return n.longValue(); }
389          case INT -> { return n.intValue(); }
390          case SHORT -> { return n.shortValue(); }
391          case BYTE -> { return n.byteValue(); }
392          case FLOAT -> { return n.floatValue(); }
393          case DOUBLE -> { return n.doubleValue(); }
394          case BIGD -> { return BigDecimal.valueOf(b ? 1 : 0); }
395        }
396      }
397      case Integer n -> {
398        switch(target) {
399          case BOOL -> { return n != 0; }
400        }
401      }
402      case Long n -> {
403        switch(target) {
404          case BOOL -> { return n != 0; }
405        }
406      }
407      case Short n -> {
408        switch(target) {
409          case BOOL -> { return n != 0; }
410        }
411      }
412      case Byte n -> {
413        switch(target) {
414          case BOOL -> { return n != 0; }
415        }
416      }
417      case BigDecimal n -> {
418        switch(target) {
419          case BOOL -> { return n.signum() != 0; }
420        }
421      }
422      case String s -> {
423        // TODO: should empty string to numeric return null?
424        try {
425          switch(target) {
426            case BOOL -> { return Boolean.valueOf(s); }
427            
428            case LONG -> { return Long.valueOf(s); }
429            case INT -> { return Integer.valueOf(s); }
430            
431            case SHORT -> { return Short.valueOf(s); }
432            case BYTE -> { return Byte.valueOf(s); }
433            
434            case FLOAT -> { return Float.valueOf(s); }
435            case DOUBLE -> { return Double.valueOf(s); }
436            case BIGD -> { return new BigDecimal(s); }
437            
438            // TODO: add date converstions.
439            // TODO: add other converstions.
440          }
441        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
442          throw new SqlConversionException(sf("Convert '%s' to %s: %s",
443              s, target, ex.getMessage()), ex);
444        }
445      }
446      default -> {}
447    }
448    // clang-format on
449    return CanNotConvert;
450  }
451
452  private static Object internalConvertObjectDateType(Object sourceValue, Clazz source,
453                                                      Clazz target) {
454    switch (target) {
455      case TIMESTAMP -> {
456        switch (source) {
457          case DATE, TIME, UTILDATE -> {
458            return new java.sql.Timestamp(((Date) sourceValue).getTime());
459          }
460          case LOCALDATETIME -> {
461            return java.sql.Timestamp.valueOf((LocalDateTime) sourceValue);
462          }
463        }
464      }
465      case DATE -> { // year,month,day at midnight - no time
466        // TODO: switch on sourceValue
467        switch (source) {
468          case UTILDATE -> {
469            java.sql.Timestamp ts = new java.sql.Timestamp(((Date) sourceValue).getTime());
470            return java.sql.Date.valueOf(ts.toLocalDateTime().toLocalDate());
471          }
472          case TIMESTAMP -> {
473            java.sql.Timestamp ts = ((java.sql.Timestamp) sourceValue);
474            return java.sql.Date.valueOf(ts.toLocalDateTime().toLocalDate());
475          }
476          case LOCALDATETIME -> {
477            return java.sql.Date.valueOf(((LocalDateTime) sourceValue).toLocalDate());
478          }
479          case LOCALDATE -> {
480            return java.sql.Date.valueOf((LocalDate) sourceValue);
481          }
482        }
483      }
484      case TIME -> {
485        switch (source) {
486          case UTILDATE -> {
487            java.sql.Timestamp ts = new java.sql.Timestamp(((Date) sourceValue).getTime());
488            return java.sql.Time.valueOf(ts.toLocalDateTime().toLocalTime());
489          }
490          case TIMESTAMP -> {
491            java.sql.Timestamp ts = ((java.sql.Timestamp) sourceValue);
492            return java.sql.Time.valueOf(ts.toLocalDateTime().toLocalTime());
493          }
494          case LOCALDATETIME -> {
495            return java.sql.Time.valueOf(((LocalDateTime) sourceValue).toLocalTime());
496          }
497          case LOCALTIME -> {
498            return java.sql.Time.valueOf((LocalTime) sourceValue);
499          }
500        }
501      }
502        // clang-format off
503      case LOCALDATETIME -> {
504        switch(source) {
505          case TIMESTAMP -> { return ((java.sql.Timestamp)sourceValue).toLocalDateTime(); }
506          case DATE -> { return ((java.sql.Date)sourceValue).toLocalDate().atStartOfDay(); }
507        }
508        // case TIME -> {
509        //  LocalTime lt = ((java.sql.Time)sourceValue).toLocalTime()...;
510        // }
511      }
512      case LOCALDATE -> {
513        switch(source) {
514          //case TIMESTAMP -> { } ???
515          case DATE -> { return ((java.sql.Date)sourceValue).toLocalDate(); }
516        }
517      }
518      case LOCALTIME -> {
519        switch(source) {
520          //case TIMESTAMP -> { } ???
521          case TIME -> { return ((java.sql.Time)sourceValue).toLocalTime(); }
522        }
523      }
524    }
525    // clang-format on
526    return CanNotConvert;
527  }

543  /**
544   * Copy the elements of the objects array into into
545   * an array of the correct type for the {@code JDBCType}d objects.
546   * <p>
547   * If an array or even a collection of the accurate type is desired,
548   * you can do the follow which is type safe, no compiler warnings.
549   * There will be an exception if something is afoul.
550   *
551   * {@snippet class=ConvertTypeSnippets region=convert_array}
552   *
553   * @param objects array of objects to cast
554   * @param jdbcType cast objects to this JDBCType
555   * @return array of corresponding type to the cast input objects
556   * @throws SQLException This exception wraps a {@code ClassCastException}
557   */
558  public static Object[] castJDBCToJava(JDBCType jdbcType, Object[] objects) throws SQLException {
559    Class<?> clazz = findJavaTypeClass(jdbcType);
560    Object[] newArray = (Object[]) java.lang.reflect.Array.newInstance(clazz, objects.length);
561    try {
562      System.arraycopy(objects, 0, newArray, 0, objects.length);
563    } catch (ArrayStoreException ex) {
564      throw new SQLException(ex);
565    }
566    return newArray;
567  }

569  /**
570   * Cast the object to {@code JDBCType}.The idea is to verify the the object
571   * is of the correct type.
572   *
573   * @param object object to cast
574   * @param jdbcType cast object to this JDBCType
575   * @return Essentially the same Object that was input
576   * @throws SQLException This exception wraps a {@code ClassCastException}
577   */
578  public static Object castJDBCToJava(JDBCType jdbcType, Object object) throws SQLException {
579    try {
580      return findJavaTypeClass(jdbcType).cast(object);
581    } catch (ClassCastException ex) {
582      throw new SQLException(ex);
583    }
584  }

586  /**
587   * Determine the Java type class for the given database type.
588   * @param jdbcType JDBCType of interest
589   * @return the class object used for the given type
590   * @throws SQLException if the JDBCType is not handled
591   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B.3 JDBC Types Mapped to Java Object Types
592   */
593  public static Class<?> findJavaTypeClass(JDBCType jdbcType) throws SQLException {
594    Class<?> clazz = overrideJdbcToJavaType.getOrDefault(jdbcType, null);
595    if (clazz != null) {
596      if (clazz == Exception.class) {
597        throw new SqlUnhandledTypeException(jdbcType.toString());
598      }
599      return clazz;
600    }
601
602    if (!isHandledType(jdbcType))
603      throw new SqlUnhandledTypeException(jdbcType.toString());
604
605    return JdbcDataTypeConversionTables.jdbcTypeToClassStrict(jdbcType);
606
607    // NOTE: No coversion for the following:
608    // ARRAY BINARY VARBINARY LONGVARBINARY CLOB BLOB REF DATALINK
609    // ROWID NCLOB SQLXML DISTINCT STRUCT JAVA_OBJECT
610  }

612  private static final Object CanNotConvert = new Object();
613
614  private static Map<Class<?>, Clazz> mapClazz = new HashMap<>();
615  static enum Clazz {
616    STRING(String.class),
617    BOOL(Boolean.class),
618
619    // TODO: how to handle primitives?
620    //      - INT(List.of(Integer.class, int.class))
621    //      - PINT
622    //      - don't have primitives *** this seems right
623
624    INT(Integer.class, true, true),
625    SHORT(Short.class, true, true),
626    BYTE(Byte.class, true, true),
627    LONG(Long.class, true, true),
628
629    FLOAT(Float.class, true, false),
630    DOUBLE(Double.class, true, false),
631    BIGD(BigDecimal.class, true, false),
632
633    UTILDATE(Date.class, true),
634    DATE(java.sql.Date.class, true),
635    TIME(java.sql.Time.class, true),
636    TIMESTAMP(java.sql.Timestamp.class, true),
637
638    LOCALDATE(java.time.LocalDate.class, true),
639    LOCALTIME(java.time.LocalTime.class, true),
640    LOCALDATETIME(java.time.LocalDateTime.class, true),
641
642    // TODO: OFFSETTIME, OFFSETDATETIME
643    ;
644
645    public static Clazz getClazz(Class<?> c) {
646      return mapClazz.get(c);
647    }
648
649    private final boolean isNumeric;
650    private final boolean isIntegral;
651    private final boolean isDateTime;
652
653    // Not a number, not a date/time.
654    Clazz(Class<?> clazz) {
655      mapClazz.put(clazz, this);
656      this.isNumeric = false;
657      this.isIntegral = false;
658      this.isDateTime = false;
659    }
660
661    // A number value.
662    @SuppressWarnings("LeakingThisInConstructor")
663    Clazz(Class<?> clazz, boolean isNumeric, boolean isIntegral) {
664      mapClazz.put(clazz, this);
665      this.isNumeric = isNumeric;
666      this.isIntegral = isIntegral;
667      this.isDateTime = false;
668    }
669
670    // A Date/Time value.
671    @SuppressWarnings("LeakingThisInConstructor")
672    Clazz(Class<?> clazz, boolean isDateTime) {
673      if (!isDateTime)
674        throw new IllegalArgumentException();
675      mapClazz.put(clazz, this);
676      this.isNumeric = false;
677      this.isIntegral = false;
678      this.isDateTime = isDateTime;
679    }
680
681    boolean isNumeric() {
682      return isNumeric;
683    }
684
685    public boolean isIntegral() {
686      return isNumeric && isIntegral;
687    }
688
689    public boolean isFloating() {
690      return isNumeric && !isIntegral;
691    }
692
693    boolean isDateTime() {
694      return isDateTime;
695    }
696  }

750  /**
751   * Using the JDBCType convert a String to an Object.
752   * @param _jdbcType convert to Object type associated with this type.
753   * @param _text string value
754   * @return object of value
755   * @throws NumberFormatException conversion error
756   */
757  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
758  private static Object parseText_NOT_USED(JDBCType _jdbcType, String _text)
759      throws NumberFormatException {
760    // if (!textUpdateOK.contains(_jdbcType)) {
761    //  throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported parseText data type: " + _jdbcType.getName());
762    // }
763
764    Object value;
765
766    // TODO: Object value = switch(_jdbtype) ****** except this is unused
767    switch (_jdbcType) {
768      case INTEGER -> value = Integer.valueOf(_text);
769
770      case SMALLINT -> value = Short.valueOf(_text);
771
772      case TINYINT -> value = Byte.valueOf(_text);
773
774      case BIGINT -> value = Long.valueOf(_text);
775
776      case REAL -> value = Float.valueOf(_text);
777
778      case FLOAT, DOUBLE -> value = Double.valueOf(_text);
779      case DECIMAL, NUMERIC -> value = new BigDecimal(_text);
780
781      case BOOLEAN, BIT -> // CONVERT THE GIVEN STRING TO BOOLEAN TYPE
782        value = Boolean.valueOf(_text);
783      case DATE -> {
784        // TODO Good to get rid of getSQLDate if possible.
785        if (_text.length() == 10) {
786          //*****// value = SSCommon.getSQLDate(_text);
787          value = null;
788        } else {
789          // 2020-12-01_BP: Might as well at least try to process a date that is other than 10 characters
790          value = java.sql.Date.valueOf(_text);
791        }
792      }
793
794      case TIME -> value = java.sql.Time.valueOf(_text);
795      case TIMESTAMP -> {
796        // TODO: We're not doing anything here
797        // TODO: Probably a better way to handle date to timestamp conversion.
798        //       Formatter? Get rid of getSQLDate() if possible.
799        // CONVERT ANY 10 CHARACTER DATE (e.g., yyyy-mm-dd, mm/dd/yyyy to a date/time)
800        if (_text.length() == 10) {
801          //*****// value = new Timestamp(SSCommon.getSQLDate(_text).getTime());
802          value = null;
803        } else {
804          // Per ER email 2020-11-25, we weren't even trying to handle a legitimate timestamp
805          value = java.sql.Timestamp.valueOf(_text);
806        }
807      }
808
809      case CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR -> value = _text;
810
811      default -> throw new IllegalStateException("switch cases out of sync");
812    } // end switch
813
814    return value;
815  }
